name: CR-8 takedown rifle
description: The CR-8 takedown rifle was a high-performance blaster rifle produced by Corellian Arms. Designed to arm Corellian Security Forces snipers and secret agents, the CR-8 was built to exacting standards; long, deadly, and made for long-range pinpoint accuracy, measuring just shy of two meters. The CR-8's modified firing system used a supercharged actuator, upgraded XCiter, and a high-output proprietary blaster gas to improve ranged accuracy by reducing beam refraction and degradation and increase firepower. However, the CR-8 produced inordinate amounts of heat, which was offset by a low rate of fire.
